name: Heaven For A Heathen
source:
Porn star Timothy Charmaine is heading to hell when he dies--not exactly a shock.  What is a shock is the fact that an angel claims he can sneak Timothy into heaven--in exchange for a favor, of course.

[From [url=https://sacredveins.itch.io/heaven-for-a-heathen]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
色情明星蒂莫西·佘诗曼死后将下地狱——这并不令人震惊。令人震惊的是，一位天使声称他可以将提摩太带入天堂——当然，这是为了换取一个恩惠。

[来自[url=https://sacredveins.itch.io/heaven-for-a-heathen]itch.io[/url]]
